headline: Congress ended the COVID-19 national emergency that the President declared on March 13, 2020.
what_it_does: This joint resolution ends the national emergency for COVID-19 that was declared on March 13, 2020. Under a national emergency, the federal government can use certain special powers and flexible rules. Ending the emergency means those emergency-based powers tied to this declaration stop.

who_it_affects.how: They can no longer rely on this COVID-19 national emergency declaration to use special emergency powers or waive certain rules.
Some flexible rules that depended on this emergency declaration may end, though the official summary does not list which ones.
